goal: Is ke baad aap Program Development Life Cycle ke stages ke naam bata sakein ge, yeh keh sakein ge ke har stage kya produce karta hai, aur ek chhote se problem ko analysis se le kar working C++ program tak pahuncha sakein ge.
warmup: Aap ka dost kehta hai ke 20 mehmanon ke liye biryani pakao. Kya aap seedha kitchen mein ja kar fry karna shuru kar dete hain? Nahi. Pehle aap poochte hain: kitne mehman hain, unhein kya pasand hai, mere paas kya hai? Phir aap steps ka plan banate hain. Phir pakate hain. Phir chakh kar dekhte hain. Phir serve karte hain, aur agli dafa namak theek kar lete hain. Achay programmers bhi aise hi kaam karte hain: pehle sochte hain, baad mein type karte hain.
definition: Program Development Life Cycle (PDLC) un stages ka set hai jinhein programmer kisi problem ko working program mein badalne ke liye follow karta hai. Stages yeh hain: Problem Analysis, Algorithm Design, Coding, Translation and Debugging, Execution and Testing, aur Implementation and Maintenance. Algorithm clear steps ki ek finite, ordered list hoti hai jo problem hal karti hai. Pseudocode woh algorithm hota hai jo simple English jaisi lines mein likha ho. Flowchart algorithm ka diagram hota hai jo standard symbols aur arrows se banta hai.
howItWorks: Problem se shuru karein, code se nahi. Problem Analysis mein aap Input (di gayi data), Output (chahiye hua result), Processing (beech ki calculation ya decision) aur Constraints (hadein, jaise marks 0 se 100 tak hon) ki list banate hain. Algorithm Design mein aap in steps ko pseudocode mein likhte hain aur flowchart banate hain: oval = Start/End, parallelogram = Input/Output, rectangle = Process, diamond = Decision. Us ke baad hi aap C++ likhte hain (Coding). Compiler aap ka code translate karta hai aur ghaltiyan batata hai (Translation and Debugging). Aap program ko mukhtalif inputs se chala kar test karte hain (Execution and Testing). Aakhir mein users usay use karna shuru karte hain, aur zaroorat par aap usay update karte hain (Implementation and Maintenance). Agar kisi stage par koi problem nazar aaye to aap pichle stage par wapas ja sakte hain.
